entry.title: OB-Xd MPC 0.4.7
entry.summary: ## Changes - **More patches, plain names.** The converted banks lose the "CC0" in their names (Keys, Bass+Lead, Pads+FX) and five more banks join them (Keys 2, Bass+Lead 2, Pads 2, Strings+Brass 2, FX+Drums 2) with about 390 extra patches in the style of OB-Xd's own factory sounds, including the Voices and Atmospheres categories, drums and percussion. entry.title: OB-Xd MPC 0.4.6
entry.summary: ## Changes - **Projects remember the sound.** A saved project keeps OB-Xd's bank, patch, every knob, the tuning and the theme, and a reload brings them back in one go. The bank is found by its file and the patch by its name, so adding banks to `my-banks` doesn't change which one a project opens. - **Five new themes:** Ocean, Violet, MPC Black (red displays on ash black), Tangerine and Jade. entry.title: OB-Xd MPC 0.4.5
entry.summary: OB-Xd virtual analog polysynth (unofficial port). ## Requirements - A first-generation MPC OS standalone device (32-bit ARM, like the Force, MPC Live / Live II, One, X and Key 61). The installer refuses anything else. Newer models are untested. - **Root shell access** (SSH) to the device. Stock MPC OS doesn't offer this; you need a modded unit. - Tested on MPC OS with a Force.
